[SWS_DM_02035] Reporting successful file transfer to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service RequestFileTransfer is received, which re-
sults in a positive response, the DM shall report a security event
SEV_UDS_REQUEST_FILE_TRANSFER_SUCCESSFUL to IdsM (see [26] and
table [SWS_DM_02036]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02036].
⌋
